rows.en: The fighting still rages on Earth.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: Poseidal, scheming to prolong the war, and several forces preying on Earth's chaos.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: Unless we wipe them all out, an era of peace will never come.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: We will join a mop-up operation against enemy forces led by the United Space Force.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: Kilimanjaro Base is gone, and the ringleader, Jamitov Hymem, is dead.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: With this, the Titans have collapsed.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: From here on, we face a continuing all-out war with the enemy forces left on Earth.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: It will be one hard battle after another, but hold on until the situation stabilizes.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: Once the war is over, we intend to back Relena Peacecraft
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: as head of the new government, and support the path to peace between Earth and space.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: She is the one who can build the era we are striving for.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: To make that a reality, please lend us your strength a little longer.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)

rows.en: Peace now rests on all of you. Do not forget that as you fight.
rows.speaker: briefing commander (unnamed)
